thread:
Mia (PMM): Quick idea — add a 3-question mini-quiz on the pricing page to help people pick a tier and route high-intent answers to SDRs. short form, optional email capture. thoughts? :zap:
Sam (Growth): love this. can we A/B test it vs current CTA? metric: % conversion to signup and lead quality score.
Devon (Design): I can sketch a compact modal and an inline variant. thinking 1) use-case, 2) concurrency/scale need, 3) data residency. keeps it scannable.
Priya (Sales): if someone chooses "dedicated/private" we should flag them as enterprise lead and route to Priya-team queue. add a required email only on the final step for routing.
Mia (PMM): exactly — routing rules: dedicated/private -> enterprise SDRs; hosted + <50k tokens/mo -> self-serve. add a microsurvey question about latency requirement.
Luke (Analytics): need event plan. minimal events: pricing_quiz_shown, pricing_quiz_start, pricing_quiz_submit, pricing_quiz_choice. capture choice values and email hash. also track experiment id.
Anne (Dev): can add a lightweight client-side quiz with server-side webhook for routing. prefer not to block page load. will post the webhook spec here when ready.
Sam (Growth): also consider funnel placement: inline under hero vs as exit-intent modal. hypothesis: inline increases completions, modal increases email capture. run both.
Devon (Design): copy options: short/explicit vs conversational. draft A: "Which setup matches your needs?" draft B: "Help us match you to the right plan." I'll A/B test.
Priya (Sales): quick routing note — include checkbox "I want a sales call" if enterprise chosen. that improves SDR prioritization.
Mia (PMM): do we want tier renaming in the quiz results? e.g., Show "Redwood Hosted / Dedicated / Private" but also friendly labels like "Starter — Hosted" etc.
Sam (Growth): friendly labels help comprehension. keep internal model names for analytics but show user-friendly names.
Luke (Analytics): agree. event payload should include displayed_label and internal_tier_id. also add utm_source if present.
Anne (Dev): posting the minimal webhook payload prototype:
```
POST /api/pricing-quiz
{
  "userEmailHash": "sha256(...)",
  "choice": "private",
  "displayLabel": "Private (on-prem)",
  "intentScore": "enterprise",
  "experiment": "pricing_quiz_v1"
}
```
Devon (Design): UI nit — use progress dots so people know it's 3 steps. microcopy for the email step: "optional — only needed if you want a tailored plan."
Mia (PMM): timeline: design by Fri, dev spike Mon, soft launch next Wed. Sam/Luke — can you own the A/B test config and success metrics?
Sam (Growth): yep, I'll set up experiment targeting 50/50 new visitors and record lift on signup + qualified leads.
Luke (Analytics): I'll add the events to tracking plan and wire up dashboards: quiz starts/completions, leads by tier, conversion within 14 days.
Priya (Sales): once live, can we get a daily digest to the SDR Slack channel with top enterprise quiz submissions? simple CSV or webhook.
Anne (Dev): launch-bot will post deploy notices. tagging launch-bot to remind the team for cutover.
launch-bot: scheduled deployment created for branch pricing-quiz/v1 at 2024-11-06T17:00Z. :party-parrot:
Mia (PMM): great — I'll create a follow-up doc in Notion with mockups and routing matrix. thanks everyone! :rocket:
